user_query: I'm planning a surprise birthday party for my best friend and I need some ideas for the party theme and decorations. Can you suggest some popular party themes and provide me with images of decorations related to those themes? Also, recommend some nearby stores where I can purchase the decorations.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of popular party themes suitable for a birthday party.
Gather images of decorations that correspond to the listed party themes.
Identify and list nearby stores that sell decorations for the selected party themes.
